function config({homeserver,memberRoom,announcementRoom}){if(typeof homeserver!=='string'||homeserver.includes('YOUR_')||!/^https:\/\/[^/?#@\s]+(?:\/[^?#\s]*)?$/i.test(homeserver))throw Error('Configure an HTTPS Matrix homeserver without credentials');for(const room of [memberRoom,announcementRoom])if(typeof room!=='string'||room.includes('YOUR_')||!/^![^\s/:]+:[^\s/]+$/.test(room))throw Error('Configure both Matrix room IDs');const base=homeserver.replace(/\/+$/,''),prefix=base+'/_matrix/client/v3/rooms/',txn=Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);return{base,memberRoom,announcementRoom,greetingUrl:prefix+encodeURIComponent(memberRoom)+'/send/m.room.message/'+txn,membersUrl:prefix+encodeURIComponent(memberRoom)+'/members',greeting:{msgtype:'m.text',body:"👋 Happy Monday Groups for this week's virtual coffee are:"}}}

return [{json:config({homeserver:'https://YOUR_MATRIX_HOMESERVER',memberRoom:'!YOUR_MEMBER_ROOM:example.org',announcementRoom:'!YOUR_ANNOUNCEMENT_ROOM:example.org'})}];

parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json;if(typeof body?.event_id!=='string'||!body.event_id)throw Error('Matrix did not confirm the greeting');return [{json:body}];

function groups({body}){if(!Array.isArray(body?.chunk))throw Error('Matrix returned no member list');const users=body.chunk.map(e=>{if(e?.type!=='m.room.member'||typeof e.state_key!=='string'||!/^@[^\s:]+:[^\s]+$/.test(e.state_key))throw Error('Invalid Matrix member event');return e.state_key});if(new Set(users).size!==users.length)throw Error('Duplicate Matrix member');if(users.length<2)return{groups:[]};for(let n=users.length;n>0;n--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*n);[users[n-1],users[j]]=[users[j],users[n-1]]}const groups=[];for(let i=0;i<users.length;i+=3)groups.push(users.slice(i,i+3));if(groups.at(-1).length===1)groups.at(-1).push(groups.at(-2).shift());return{groups}}

const r=groups({body:$input.first().json});return r.groups.map(group=>({json:{text:'☀️ '+group.join(', ')}}));
